settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: Rs 100 anywhere in Mauritius. Delivery is free when your order is above Rs 1,500.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders usually arrive in 1 to 3 working days.

settings.question: Can I collect my order instead?
settings.answer: Yes, in Mon Gout, by arrangement. Write to us by email or on WhatsApp and we will agree a time with you.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: By card at checkout. Card payments are processed by MIPS, so we never see your full card number.

settings.question: Are the products authentic?
settings.answer: Yes. We buy from wholesale suppliers, and every product page shows the full ingredient list, so you can compare it with the brand's own.

settings.question: Is a new product safe for my skin?
settings.answer: We advise a patch test before using any new product. Our product information is not medical advice.

settings.question: Where do the ingredient lists come from?
settings.answer: From the supplier. If anything looks different from the pack you receive, tell us.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Unopened products in their original packaging can be returned within seven days of delivery. Opened skincare cannot be returned for hygiene reasons, unless it is faulty or not what you ordered. See Delivery & returns.
